sinopsis.es: Ganadora del Premio del Jurado Joven en el 55.º Festival de Rotterdam, la ópera prima de Ang Geck Geck Priscilla es la historia agridulce y a la vez reconfortante de una niña que intenta descifrar qué significa hacerse adulta.
sinopsis.en: Winner of the Youth Jury Award at the 55th International Film Festival Rotterdam, Ang Geck Geck Priscilla’s feature debut is a bittersweet yet heartwarming story of a young girl as she tries to figure out what it means to become an adult.
